gen-fs-trench-slab-fs-asap: Chunky and oversized, Trench Slab hits hard up top, while Asap below keeps its c forms as open arcs. Slab serif against sans: that sharp difference is what you notice first.
gen-fs-trench-slab-fs-epilogue: Slab meets wire: Trench Slab brings outsized lowercase and a serif build to the heading, loud and industrial. And Epilogue draws curvy, unclamped sans letters on a wire-like monoline skeleton.
gen-fs-trench-slab-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, a dense strip of sans with letters held open. Trench Slab does its best work with outsized, industrial serif lowercase, while Supreme does its best by keeping text sturdy and uncurled.
gen-fs-trench-slab-general-sans: General Sans is a sans-serif with an x-height that fills the line and smooth, unobstructed curves around each bend. Trench Slab, a serif, against that bent-tubing sans-serif is the sharpest thing here.
gen-fs-trench-slab-manrope: Chunky and industrial, Trench Slab is best at making a statement with oversized serif lowercase. Manrope is best at the quieter job: one line width and bright gaps at each curve's mouth.
gen-fs-trench-slab-montserrat: Trench Slab arrives with industrial swagger, its outsized serif lowercase giving every heading a sturdy, modern punch. Montserrat then glides along, constant as wire, with white space before each curve.
gen-fs-trench-slab-satoshi: Loud slab, quiet curves: Trench Slab brings outsized serif lowercase, industrial and modern. Satoshi counters with a soaring x-height, a wide-open e and strokes that never vary in weight.
gen-fs-trench-slab-work-sans: Outsized lowercase gives Trench Slab its serif muscle. Work Sans, a sans-serif with constant-width strokes like bent pipe and c tips that stay well apart, handles the quieter text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee reads soft and friendly, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. Autour One, a display face with a clear channel into each round letter, gives the heading its voice while ABeeZee holds the line.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-aldrich: Aldrich reads modern and crisp, its x-height nearly level with the capitals. Autour One brings bold, expressive display shapes with no hairline-to-stem shift, which is the thick, single-thread quality both fonts share.
